name: Mechacyte
source:
A few months ago, the war ended, and with it, the world. Eris is a burnt out mech handler and Luna is her overeager responsibility. It's up to Eris to help guide Luna, pointing her where she's supposed to go, but when you're stuck looking back, it's hard to move forward.

[From [url=https://blush-hazard.itch.io/mechacyte]itch.io[/url]]
